basics.name: Armando Peña Tamayo
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer | SaaS Architecture | LLMs & RAG
basics.summary: Senior full-stack AI engineer with 8 years of experience designing and delivering production software end to end, from architecture and data modeling to implementation, integration, and deployment. I build multi-tenant SaaS and production-oriented AI systems: LLM integrations, RAG and vector databases, multi-stage agent orchestration, custom tools, and deterministic validation around probabilistic outputs. I work remotely with international engineering teams and treat reliability, security, and concurrency as core architectural concerns.

work.name: CBS Cleaning
work.summary: Production-oriented AI automation platform for a document-heavy email back office. Built a hybrid deterministic/LLM pipeline: deterministic ETL and normalization, multi-format document extraction (including image-based text), Qdrant-backed RAG over indexed email documents and attachments, and multi-stage n8n agent orchestration with Structured Outputs and tool calling. Agents retrieved geographic and tax information through custom tools, selected OpenAI models by task complexity (GPT-4.5 and smaller models), and shared temporary per-email workflow state through Redis. Deterministic validators using the same APIs cross-checked low-confidence results. Added retry/recovery paths, concurrency controls, and duplicate/conflict prevention for SharePoint writes while processing hundreds of emails daily—thousands during initial rollout—cutting manual processing time by ~70%.

work.name: SuitUp Project
work.summary: Mobile-first body-measurement and virtual try-on MVP for fashion e-commerce. Owned the full-stack build: Next.js architecture, camera-based capture flow, measurement processing, and AR try-on integration. Shipped in four months, reducing time-to-market by ~50% versus typical product timelines.

work.name: AmerAdjust
work.summary: AI document-generation platform for the insurance industry, built from the MVP stage. Designed and implemented multi-tenancy from scratch: organization tenant IDs on business records, Supabase RLS enabled by default for new business-data tables through migrations, tenant-scoped hierarchical RBAC, and defense-in-depth authorization across database RLS and application middleware. Tenant administrators can access all users within their own organization; global administrators can operate across tenants; ordinary users and organizations remain isolated. Also built the Next.js/Supabase product and AI document pipeline, reducing document creation from hours to minutes (~80%). Implemented at MVP stage; multi-organization behavior was not yet validated in production.

projects.name: AI Job Hunter — Personal Agent System
projects.description: Independent personal project. Autonomous agents research the web to discover and extract job opportunities, normalize listings, and evaluate eligibility with custom tools plus deterministic rules for geographic restrictions, payment-method compatibility, role type, and technical requirements. Multi-stage orchestration combines structured job processing and LLM reasoning with rule-based validation, then adapts the CV and generates a tailored cover letter for each position.

projects.name: AI Security Testing Agents — Personal Project
projects.description: Personal AI-assisted application security testing toolkit. Orchestrates agents to run active scans with Burp Suite Community Edition and OWASP ZAP, apply OWASP-guided checks and vulnerability checklists, and surface findings for review during development. Complements manual validation and professional penetration testing; it does not certify security or guarantee vulnerability detection.
